rawReferences.name: saveWorld/loadWorld naming
rawReferences.summary: World is root entity; saveWorld/loadWorld on IEntityRepository persist/load the root. Resolved: these are correct names for the interface methods, not aliases for save()

rawReferences.name: sync on interface
rawReferences.summary: sync() removed from IEntityRepository: it decomposes into loadWorld() + findMany(). Event-driven change notification is a separate concern (event bus), not a repo method. Resolved: drop sync from interface.

rawReferences.name: findMany return type
rawReferences.summary: findMany<T extends EntityConstructor>(EntityClass: T, filter: object): AsyncGenerator<ReturnType<T['fromJson']>>. Same MongoDB-style filter as findOne. FileRepository iterates matching files; MongoDB uses native query cursor. Resolved.

rawReferences.name: findOne primitive
rawReferences.summary: findOne<T extends EntityConstructor>(EntityClass: T, filter: object): ReturnType<T['fromJson']>|null. MongoDB-style filter e.g. {id:'abc123'}. FileRepository scans files and matches fields; MongoDB uses native query. Resolved.

rawReferences.name: insertOne generic constraint
rawReferences.summary: insertOne<T extends EntityConstructor>(EntityClass: T, cfg: object): ReturnType<T['fromJson']>. World.insertOne already has this signature — preserve it on IEntityRepository unchanged. Resolved.
